column1: # Raw-limb identity of Rgemm_NT_omp vs the serial NT body it replaced (review2 §8.4).
# v3, 2026-08-09. History of this table, because two earlier versions overstated coverage:
#   v1 advertised '~20% structural zeros' and placed NONE -- its generator documented
#      [-1,1) and returned [0,2), so the zero predicate never fired (review2 §10.1); it
#      also labelled gate_open from the work term alone, marking 27 n=1 cases open.
#   v2 fixed both, but counted zeros over the WHOLE padded B allocation, of which the
#      kernel reads only the first n rows: 2049 of its 28960 were padding (review2 §13.2).
#   v3 counts only the read region: 26911 real structural zeros across the 135 cases.
# Harness: patches/qd_nt_kernel_check.cpp (recipe) / bench/qd_nt_kernel_check.cpp (solver),
# Kernel object: fixes/sdpa-qd-omp/sdpa_qd-Rgemm_NT_omp.o (md5 8477013e5786ffcdae5ac7cddbb349db)
#          from qd fork tree 9aed141
# Compiler: g++-16 (Homebrew GCC 16.1.0) 16.1.0; machine: mac-m1max
# meta cases_per_thread=135 thread_counts=1,4,8 gate_open=74 gate_closed=61 zeros_read_region=26911
# gate_open = the EXACT production predicate: m*n*k >= MPACK_OMP_MIN_GEMM_WORK (512) AND
#          n >= MPACK_OMP_MIN_GEMM_WIDTH (2); the generator RECOMPUTES it from the recorded
#          dimensions and the fork's tuning header, so a flipped bit fails generation.
# Self-tests run before the cases and abort the harness on failure: fill range spans
#          negatives, zero predicate fires at rate, a 1e-60 limb perturbation IS detected,
#          a padding write IS detected. A comparison that cannot fail proves nothing.
# 135 cases per thread count, memcmp over every qd_real limb: 0 failures at 1, 4, 8 threads.
m
